_note: Closed list for Win.criterion_hint. A hint for the lawyer, not a legal determination. Source: 8 CFR 214.2(o)(3)(iii)(B). Default depends on win_type (see default_by_win_type); Augusto can override on confirm.

values.original_contribution: Experts engaging, adopting or building on a named claim (iii)(B)(5)
values.published_about: Published material in professional or major media about Augusto and his work (iii)(B)(3)
values.scholarly_authorship: Citation of his scholarly articles in professional journals or major media (iii)(B)(6)
values.judging: Invited to judge or review others' work, e.g. a referee or panel invite (iii)(B)(4)
values.none: Engagement worth logging that supports no criterion
